name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow with safe isolated integration, task governance, and approved mature-workflow delegation.

interface.shortDescription: One confirmed plan for complex multi-AI work; safe local integration.
interface.longDescription: Silently defer to a repository's mature workflow, or use its exact locally approved adapter without taking ownership of project state. Simple work keeps the familiar isolated lifecycle; complex work gets one plain-language plan confirmation, then a central controller schedules up to five independent workers with local-only DWW integration and evidence-led completion. Multi-step work uses temporary task anchors and durable facts stay in one authoritative home. Explicit publishing remains a separate dry-run-first, non-force operation after Finish.
capabilities: Temporary task anchors and durable-document routing
defaultPrompt: Use the repository's required workflow for this Git change.
Handle this change in an isolated worktree and finish the managed lifecycle.
